record.one_liner: Higgsfield provides AI image and video generation tools primarily accessed through an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and CLI rather than a traditional developer REST API.

auth_methods.quote: Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.

access_test.quote: 1. Install the CLI: run `npm i -g @higgsfield/cli` . 2. Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.

access_ship.quote: Do I need an API key? No. Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account.

api_type.quote: How does Higgsfield connect to AI agents? Higgsfield uses MCP (Model Context Protocol), an open standard that gives AI agents access to external tools.

api_breadth.quote: Once connected, your agent can generate images, create videos, train characters, and browse your creation history, all within a single session.

official_mcp.quote: Higgsfield uses MCP (Model Context Protocol), an open standard that gives AI agents access to external tools.
